name: Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Tool by PlusCodes
author: plusCodes

sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder pluscodes-product-csv-import-export-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or search for “PlusCodes Import Export” in the WordPress Plugin Directory and click Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Import / Export in your WordPress admin sidebar to access the dashboard.
sections.faq:
How is this plugin better than WebToffee Import Export for WooCommerce?

PlusCodes offers several features that WebToffee locks behind its premium tier — all for free. These include: full variable product CSV import export, custom batch size control, export by specific product IDs, a custom export filename field, and a custom CSV delimiter. PlusCodes is also built exclusively on WooCommerce’s native CSV engine with zero third-party dependencies, giving you better performance and compatibility.

How is this plugin better than All-in-One Import Export for WooCommerce?

Unlike All-in-One Import Export plugins that try to do everything (products, orders, users, coupons) in one bloated interface, PlusCodes focuses 100% on WooCommerce product import and product export. This means a cleaner UI, faster processing, and a smaller plugin footprint with no unused code weighing down your store.

Does this plugin support variable products for free?

Yes — 100%. PlusCodes supports complete variable product import and product export in the free version, including all variation data (SKU, price, sale price, stock, weight, dimensions, and attributes). Competitors like WebToffee restrict variable product support to their paid plans.

How do I run a WooCommerce product import from a CSV file?

Go to Import / Export → Import in your WordPress admin. Upload your CSV file, use auto-map to match columns automatically (or map them manually), then click Run Import. The plugin processes your file in batches, shows real-time progress, and updates your store without timeouts.

How do I export WooCommerce products to CSV?

Go to Import / Export → Export. Optionally filter by product type, category, stock status, or enter specific product IDs. Set a custom filename and click Export. Your CSV will download immediately, ready to open in Excel, Google Sheets, or LibreOffice.

Can I update existing products without creating duplicates?

Yes. Enable Update existing products before running your product import. The plugin matches incoming rows by SKU or product ID and updates the existing records — no duplicates are created.

Does this plugin support images during import and export?

Yes. Featured images and all gallery images are supported in both product import and product export. For imports, provide the full URL to each image in your CSV and the plugin will fetch and attach them automatically.

What WooCommerce product types are supported in the free version?

The free version supports CSV import export for Simple, Variable, Grouped, and External/Affiliate products. For Subscription products or other custom product types, see the Pro version.

Can I filter my product export by specific product IDs?

Yes. Enter a comma-separated list of product IDs in the Export by IDs field to include only those products in your product export — a free feature that competitors charge extra for.

Can I set a custom filename for my exported CSV?

Yes. PlusCodes includes a Custom Filename field on the export screen so you can name your file before downloading. This keeps your exports organised and is unique to PlusCodes in the free tier.

What is the custom BATCH size feature?

For large stores, you can control how many products are processed per batch during a product import or product export. This prevents server timeouts on shared hosting and is configurable for free — competitors typically charge for this.

What CSV delimiter options are available?

You can choose comma (,), semicolon (;), tab (\t), or pipe (|) as the CSV delimiter — useful when your spreadsheet software exports in a non-default format.

Does the plugin work with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. PlusCodes is fully declared compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / custom order tables).

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. PlusCodes is built on WooCommerce’s own native CSV engine and adds no third-party scripts or libraries. The footprint is minimal and it only runs when you actively use the Import/Export dashboard.

Which CSV editors work best with this plugin?

We recommend Google Sheets, LibreOffice Calc, or Microsoft Excel (O365) for editing exported CSV files, as these tools handle UTF-8 encoding correctly and preserve data integrity for your next product import.

Does this plugin work with the latest version of WooCommerce and WordPress?

Yes. PlusCodes is actively maintained and tested with the latest versions of WooCommerce (up to 9.x) and WordPress (up to 7.0).

Where can I get support?

You can open a support thread in the WordPress.org plugin support forum. For priority support and advanced features, consider upgrading to Advanced Import Export for WooCommerce (Pro).

The fastest WooCommerce product import & export CSV plugin. Import or export simple, variable, grouped & affiliate products — free, no bloat, 100% native WooCommerce CSV engine.

The #1 Focused WooCommerce Product Import & Export CSV Plugin

Tired of bloated all-in-one tools slowing down your WooCommerce store? Product Import Export for WooCommerce by PlusCodes is purpose-built for one thing: blazing-fast, reliable WooCommerce product import and product export via CSV — and it does it better than the rest.

Unlike WebToffee Import Export or All-in-One Import Export plugins, we don’t bundle unnecessary modules for orders, subscriptions, or users into a plugin you’ll never fully use. PlusCodes delivers a clean, dedicated dashboard powered 100% by WooCommerce’s native CSV engine — meaning zero compatibility conflicts, zero bloat, and maximum performance.

Need subscriptions, orders, coupons, or custom post types? Upgrade to Advanced Import Export for WooCommerce (Pro).

PLUSCODES FREE CSV IMPORT EXPORT PLUGIN

The free version of this plugin delivers complete product import and product export for all core WooCommerce product types:

  • ✅ Simple Products
  • ✅ Variable Products (with all variations — FREE)
  • ✅ Grouped Products
  • ✅ External / Affiliate Products

With PlusCodes, you can export WooCommerce products to a spreadsheet or run a full WooCommerce product import to create or update products — all using a professional, free CSV import export tool that just works.

Major Features

  • Full WooCommerce Product Import: Import products from any CSV file into WooCommerce — simple, variable, grouped, or external — all in the free version.
  • Export WooCommerce Products: Export your entire product catalogue (or a filtered subset) to a clean, ready-to-edit CSV file in seconds.
  • Variable Products — FREE: Unlike competitors that lock variable product support behind a paywall, PlusCodes includes complete variable product CSV import export for free.
  • Dedicated Import / Export Dashboard: A clean, focused admin interface designed exclusively for product CSV operations — no clutter, no confusion.
  • Export by Product IDs: Enter a comma-separated list of IDs to cherry-pick exactly which products appear in your product export — a feature competitors charge for.
  • Custom Export Filename: Name your CSV before downloading so your file management stays organised — unique to PlusCodes.
  • Auto-Map Columns: Intelligent automatic column mapping matches your CSV headers to WooCommerce fields instantly, making every product import faster.
  • Import & Export Images: Full support for featured images and gallery images during CSV import export — no extra setup required.
  • Advanced Export Filters: Refine your product export by product type, category, stock status, or specific IDs for laser-focused data exports.
  • Update Existing Products: Match by SKU or product ID to update existing store items during a WooCommerce product import — perfect for bulk price or stock updates.

Additional Features

  • Custom BATCH Processing: Control batch size to prevent server timeouts on large-catalogue product import operations — free, unlike competitors.
  • Custom CSV Delimiter: Switch between comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe delimiters to match your spreadsheet tool’s export format.
  • Categories & Tags with Hierarchy: Export and import full category trees and product tags without flattening the structure.
  • Custom Meta Fields: Include any custom product metadata in your CSV import export — no coding required.
  • Real-time Progress Tracker: A live, animated progress bar shows you exactly where your product import or product export stands at all times.
  • Lightweight & WooCommerce-Native: Built directly on WooCommerce’s own CSV engine for 100% data integrity and maximum compatibility with every WooCommerce version.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / custom order tables).
  • No Third-Party Libraries: Zero external scripts or tracking — your store data stays private and your site stays fast.

Key Use Cases

Migrate Products Between WooCommerce Stores

Moving your store to a new domain or a new host? Export all products — simple, variable, grouped, and affiliate — and import them into your new store in minutes. The auto-mapping engine handles column alignment so you don’t have to.

Bulk Update Prices & Stock Levels

Export your catalogue to Excel or Google Sheets, edit prices or stock in bulk, then re-import using the “Update existing products” option. PlusCodes matches by SKU or ID and updates only what changed.

Import or Export Product Images

Include featured images and gallery image URLs directly in your CSV. PlusCodes fetches and attaches them during product import — no manual uploading required.

Run Selective, Filtered Exports

Generate targeted exports for marketing reviews, stock audits, or supplier uploads by filtering your product export by category, product type, or stock status.

Sync Inventory Across Multiple Channels

Use CSV export to feed your product data into marketplaces, ERPs, or third-party fulfilment tools, and re-import updated stock after each sync cycle.

Advanced Import Export for WooCommerce (Pro)

Need more? The Advanced Import Export for WooCommerce (Pro) unlocks enterprise-grade capabilities:

  • ✅ Full CSV import export for Products, Orders, Customers/Users, Reviews, Subscriptions, and Coupons.
  • ✅ XML file format support alongside CSV.
  • ✅ Advanced mapping screen with conditional field logic.
  • ✅ Three import/export methods (standard, delta, merge).
  • ✅ Scheduled import & export via FTP / SFTP profiles.
  • ✅ Bulk update any WooCommerce store data via import.
  • ✅ Support for Subscription products and other custom product types.
  • ✅ Securely retain and migrate user passwords between sites.
  • ✅ Import/export images and custom meta at scale.
  • ✅ Priority 24/7 customer support.

About PlusCodes

PlusCodes creates professional, high-performance WordPress and WooCommerce tools designed to make store management faster, simpler, and more reliable. We believe essential features should be free — so we give you more in our free tier than competitors do in their paid plans.
